name: SCALE: Sustainable Climate Analysis & Energy Decision Lab
tagline: Climate and energy analysis for better decisions
institution: School of Industrial Engineering, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso (PUCV)
mission: Produce rigorous, decision-relevant knowledge on climate and energy systems, combining integrated assessment, mathematical optimization, and system-dynamics simulation to inform policy, planning, and investment for a sustainable and just transition.
vision: To be a leading Latin American reference in climate and energy analysis for decision-making, training engineers and analysts who design evidence-based, equitable pathways towards a sustainable future.
